response.sql:
WITH source_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.fundflux,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.arcref) as count
  FROM scanspatial s
  INNER JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
with_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fundflux,
    count,
    SUM(count) OVER () as total_count,
    AVG(count) OVER () as avg_count
  FROM source_counts
)
SELECT 
  fundflux,
  count,
  CAST(count AS REAL) / total_count as share,
  count - avg_count as excess
FROM with_stats
WHERE count > avg_count
ORDER BY fundflux

assumptions.assumption: fundflux (funding source) may be NULL; the query treats NULL as a distinct funding source group per standard SQL GROUP BY behavior

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude NULL funding sources from analysis, considering only projects with non-NULL fundflux
